out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the hand washing sink in the kitchen is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Other Liquid Wastes, Drained to Dispose per Law
violations.observation: Grease trap drain line servicing the 3-compartment sink is emptying liquid waste directly onto an opened floor drain creating strong odor in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: The drainage from the grease trap shall drain or discharge to an unopened drain/piping.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the light bulb under the cooking hood system was not working.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair or replace the bulb, to provide adequate illumination.
